rooms.name: Gatehouse
rooms.description: A cramped stone gatehouse. The portcullis behind you has rusted shut, and a draft whistles through the arrow slits.

rooms.name: Courtyard
rooms.description: An overgrown courtyard under a bruised purple sky. A dry fountain sits in the middle, full of dead leaves.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A long kitchen that still smells faintly of rosemary. Copper pots hang from hooks, and a trapdoor in the floor leads down.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.description: A low, damp cellar lined with empty wine racks. Something glints near an old blacksmith's anvil.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Towering shelves sag under mildewed books. A reading desk by the window holds a scrap of parchment.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: A vast hall with a cold hearth and a long table set for a feast nobody ate. A heavy stone slab is set into the floor, and a spiral stair climbs into the dark.

rooms.name: Bell Tower
rooms.description: The top of the keep. A great bronze bell hangs above you, its rope dangling within reach. You can see the whole valley from here.

rooms.name: Crypt
rooms.description: A silent crypt beneath the keep. On a stone plinth rests a crown that glows like the last coal in a fire.
